content: Engel anĩ dõ fiya engel taka yogon taur wese fe di, aya barisa taka saa ilunem tenebur kubũ yen anĩ ailen. Barisa are ku isil idĩya sã nẽ ki anĩ ifenen.
Ĩ ku isil idĩya sã anĩ kã fele di, kaau are yã odug kũ fiya modoũ bun tamal gen fã yen. Ku isil idĩya sã bun tamal kaau anim, gaa ado saa gugum kelen.
Age fe di, kaau namen tamal, totobi tenebur wowã den, are idi neid megeir, tenebur ãbei neid megeir gen ifenẽdin.
Idi tenebur tamal fisir be, ereb aayũ be, aa taka to daũ difouf, anĩ ere, tamo kayau idi Negur nẽ uris demeid bun sã anidi dogol daũ difediyouf nigin irokenẽdin.
Idi tamo idenkesiya nẽ megeir to ifenẽdin, anĩ ere, idi ogõ faif bun darau dogol difenẽdiyouf nigin megeir ifenẽdin. Age fe di, idi neid darau arar, ãbei tamo garũ fe di, darau arar iledig gen.
Naa anidi bun tamo laa dimirẽf, anĩ ere, to dilouf. Idi laa orodiyouf, anĩ ere, laa to gurug fediyouf.
Totobi are hos kusĩ bun ileya nẽ gegen. Idi neid mudureid bun, ereb gol teter gen kurũ difedin, idi neid neweid tamo neweid gen.
Nedi fatiyeid kayau fatiyeid gen, agef fen, waileid are laion waila gen.
Nedi siot kapa are ain nẽ siot kapa gen, agef fen, idi neid wayeid furũya are hos musei ado karis kusĩ bun gududu de fen, gou redig gen.
Idi ibud ado waileid ãbei neid gen, agef fen, idi ibud nem ogõ faif bun tamo kayau darau difenẽdiyouf nigin megeir adon.
Idi uyu iroukenẽdiya nẽ king ado, are ku isil idĩya sã nẽ engel, in yana Hibru od nem are Abadon, Grik od nem are Apolion.
Morõ odug uyulil anĩ bure felen, age fe di, morõ odug uru are fau disif.
Engel namba sigis anĩ yogon taur wese fe di, aya ait taka gol alta Negur wagen ifaref anĩ nẽ karat aiwa adodo bunem wowã yeid mog, karĩ aun.
Ait are engel namba sigis taur ado anĩ irokenen, “Engel aiwa adodo Yufretis naan odug bun difofan anidi fara woidle.”
Age ye di, engel aiwa adodo are aua, naa, ogõ, yar enei bun bagai, tamo teneub ganan bun fara fiya towo anĩ taka adok didenkesiyouf nigin, dodok fedin anĩ folõ feledin.
Hos teten kusĩ bun ileya nẽ tamo anidi are 200 milion. Aya dogo neid namba karĩ aun.

Aya malau seleulã kurã fiya bun, hos adodo tamo hos tetedin dibodon anidi eig fiya ailedin: Idi neid siot kapa are, yã giriya gen, maaĩ gegẽ gen ado, bailuya salfa gen. Hos mudureid are, laion mudureid gen, agef fen, idi eweid bunem yã, kaau ado, salfa wowã yen.
Tamo tenebur ganan faraf towo fiya gen anĩ taka ganan, sane towo anim, yã, kaau ado, salfa idi eweid bun wowã yen anim didenkesin.
Hos idi neid megeir are eweid bun ado ibud bun ibodon, ere nigin, idi neid ibud are gogour gen fen, mudureid anim tamo kayau darau difenẽdidig.

Tamo kayau tunĩ ganan, sane eneidim to didenkesin anidi, idi imedim dinon anĩ to ditor ken, waud to falei yen. Idi kaa sesen yeneid yaleseya to ditor ken, gol, silwa, bras, meein ado, aa nẽ idegẽya waitou, are lo fiya, karĩya be, iyõya kisi felya sã anidi yeneid yaleseya itorõya sã.
Idi tamo yukesiya, dogo neid idegẽya kosẽya, dogo neid noli tobonunã be, dogo neid bẽ yaleya tobonunã nigineg waud to falei yen.

footnotes.text: Abadon ado Apolion nẽ gariya, Daũ Fiya Tamo.
